source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of the second line of defence (PDF 172).

blocks.text: Jism ki difa ki pehli line bohat kaargar (effective) hai, lekin kabhi kabhi hamla awar is ko paar kar lete hain. Jab aise hamla awar gehre tissues tak pohanch jate hain to difa ki doosri line kaam shuru karti hai. Pehli line ki tarah doosri line bhi non-specific (ghair makhsoos) difa mein shumaar hoti hai, yaani yeh kisi khaas microbe ko pehchane baghair har hamla awar ke khilaf kaam karti hai.

Insaani jism doosri line mein bohat se non-specific cellular (cells wale) aur chemical (kimiyai) tareeqe istemal karta hai. In mein sab se ahem chaar yeh hain: khoon ke germ-killer cells (jaraseem maarne wale cells), antimicrobial proteins (jaraseem ke khilaf proteins), inflammatory response (sozish ka jawab) aur temperature response (hararat ka jawab, yaani bukhar).

blocks.prompt: Doosri line ko non-specific kyun kehte hain?
blocks.explanation: Kyun ke yeh kisi khaas microbe ko pehchane baghair har hamla awar ke khilaf aik hi tarah kaam karti hai.

items: Pehli line toot jaye aur hamla awar gehre tissues tak pohanchein to doosri line kaam karti hai; yeh bhi non-specific hai.
Chaar ahem hisse: germ-killer cells, antimicrobial proteins, inflammatory response, temperature response.
